issues.description: PersonResource constructor signature differs between template and solution: the template correctly injects `PersonService`, but the solution declares `public PersonResource(String personService)` and assigns it to a `PersonService` field. This causes a compile-time type error and prevents Spring dependency injection from creating the controller bean, blocking the application from running and contradicting the intended web-layer-to-service-layer wiring described in the problem statement.
issues.suggestedFix: In solution `PersonResource`, change the constructor to `public PersonResource(PersonService personService) { this.personService = personService; }` and remove the incorrect `String` parameter so it matches the template and enables Spring DI.
